_comment: Civic Resource Hub - inbound contact flow (chat + WebRTC voice).
Import via Connect console: Routing -> Flows -> Create flow -> Import flow.
After import, replace the one placeholder:
AI SELF-SERVICE ONLY. There are no human agents, so this flow contains
no queue transfer. Earlier revisions routed a 'talk to a person' intent
to General Help / Veterans / Housing queues; with nobody staffing them
that only produced a wait followed by an apology, which is worse than
being told plainly up front. The Lex fulfillment Lambda now answers that
intent by pointing at 2-1-1, 988, or the agency's own number - all lines
that really are answered by people.
No hours-of-operation check either: the guide is automated and always
available, so there is nothing to be closed for.
Prompt text is deliberately ASCII-only - non-ASCII uploaded via
--content file:// arrived as mojibake and is read aloud by TTS on voice.

Metadata.name: Civic Resource Hub - Inbound (chat + web voice)
Metadata.description: Greet, then run the Bedrock-backed Lex guide. AI self-service only - no agent transfer.

Parameters.Text: Hi, and welcome to the Civic Resource Hub. I'm an automated guide, and I can help you find public and government services in Georgia. Tell me what's going on - for example, help with food, rent, health care, or a job.
What do you need help with?
Is there anything else I can help you find?
Thanks for using the Civic Resource Hub. If you would like to talk to a real person, dial 2-1-1 any time - it is free and answered around the clock. Take care.
